plain_english: When you wake up in the morning, remind yourself: today you will meet people who are nosy, ungrateful, and full of themselves. Don't be surprised. They act that way because they don't know any better.
original_excerpt: Begin the morning by saying to thyself, I shall meet with the busy-body, the ungrateful, arrogant, deceitful, envious, unsocial.

plain_english: You could leave this life right now. Let that shape everything you do and say and think. There is no time for pettiness when death is always near.
original_excerpt: Since it is possible that thou mayest depart from life this very moment, regulate every act and thought accordingly.

plain_english: Stop arguing about what a good person should be. Just be one. Every moment you spend debating virtue is a moment you could spend practising it.
original_excerpt: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
